subject.title: fix(ui): keep first turns visible and block browser regressions

question: Should OpenClaw require this targeted Chromium new-session suite in the aggregate CI gate after its current-main rebase confirms the expected capacity and merge-time cost?
rationale: The code repair is bounded, but making a browser suite mandatory is an operational CI policy choice that automated review cannot make from a single branch run.

options.title: Require the targeted Chromium gate
options.body: Rebase and land the job once the exact merge head passes, accepting the added CI cost to prevent recurrence of the demonstrated Control UI regressions.

options.title: Keep the repair but defer mandatory gating
options.body: Land only the application and fixture fixes, then move the browser-suite gate to a separately approved CI-capacity change.

recommendation.title: Require the targeted Chromium gate
recommendation.body: Rebase and land the job once the exact merge head passes, accepting the added CI cost to prevent recurrence of the demonstrated Control UI regressions.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible feature history ties this contributor to the repaired new-session behavior and the proposed CI coverage, making them the best available routing contact for the technical tradeoff.
